steps.note: Open the single-stage create screen specified by the case.
Enable the required tenant configuration that prevents vendor additions during event creation.
Enable the required read-only ceiling-price configuration.
Set the single-stage event type to RFQ.
Provide the mandatory title needed for a valid create-screen state.
Choose the Buy pricing template required before adding the product.
Add the specified product with quantity 10.
Capture the current item indicator so the cancellation can be checked not to alter the event form.
Open the Participants window on the single-stage create screen.
Confirm that the All Vendors window opened.
Cancel the Participants window without applying changes.
Verify that the All Vendors window closed.
Verify that the visible event item state is unchanged after cancelling.
